pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Rivet Plumbing Co. is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A Rivet Plumbing service van and two uniformed technicians ready for the day

children: Rivet Plumbing Co. started with a simple frustration: why is booking a plumber still a phone call, a four-hour window, and a bill that lands higher than the quote? So we rebuilt the whole thing around the customer.
Book online. Get a real window. See the flat price before work starts. Track your tech to the door. Same trucks, same licensed people you’d want anyway — just none of the runaround.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: You approve a written price before we start. It doesn’t move — no hourly clock, no surprise line items.
Longer hours and weekend coverage mean “today” is usually a real answer, not a hopeful one.
Every tech is licensed, insured and background-checked, and every repair is backed by our workmanship guarantee.
